questions.question: **Directions: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Incandesent**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the options:-

 
 
• '**Inconclusive**' means **not leading to a definite decision or result**. (जो निश्चित निर्णय या परिणाम की ओर न ले जाए; अनिश्‍चायक, अनिर्णायक)
 
• '**Impeccable**' means **without any mistakes or faults; perfect**. (निर्दोष, त्रुटिहीन; परिपूर्ण)
 
• 'Incandesent': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
 
• ​The correct spelling is 'Incandescent' and it means **extremely bright**. (अत्यधिक चमकीला)
 
 
 
• '**Impervious**' means **not affected or influenced by something**. (जिस पर किसी बात का असर नहीं होता या जो किसी के असर में नहीं आता; अप्रभावनीय)

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

__
 
• Example of 'Incandescent' in a____ sentence__:

 
 
• *​**To preserve your eyesight, you should avoid looking directly at the **incandescent** sun*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The mouse, however, reached his hole in safety.

B. A bull was bitten by a mouse, and, pained by the wound, tried to capture him.

C. The mouse, peeping out, crept up his flank and, again biting him, retreated to his hole.

D. The bull dug into the walls with his horns until wearied, he crouched down and slept by the hole.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**a bull bitten by a mouse**". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after B as it is telling that the mouse reached safely in his hole after biting the bull.
 
• Sentence D will come after A as it is explaining what the bull had done to catch the mouse.
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it is telling how the mouse again succeded in biting the bull.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *A bull was bitten by a mouse, and, pained by the wound, tried to capture him. The mouse, however, reached his hole in safety. The bull dug into the walls with his horns until wearied, he crouched down and slept by the hole. The mouse, peeping out, crept up his flank and, again biting him, retreated to his hole.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'B' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक चूहे द्वारा काटे गए बैल" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'B' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य A, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बता रहा है कि चूहा बैल को काटने के बाद अपने छेद में सुरक्षित पहुंच गया।
 
• वाक्य D, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बता रहा है कि बैल ने चूहे को पकड़ने के लिए क्या किया है।
 
• वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह बता रहा है कि कैसे चूहे ने फिर से बैल को काटने में सफलता प्राप्त की।

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

B. The study of consumer behavior is equally important for non-profit organizations such as governmental agencies, hospitals, NGOs, charitable organizations.

C. Thus, studying consumer behavior before and during purchase helps in production scheduling, designing, pricing, positioning, segmentation, advertising and other promotional activities.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'ADCB.'

• Sentence D will come after A as it is explaining how the marketer can predict the response of the potential customers.
 
• Sentence C will come after D as it is explaining how the customer behavior study helps the marketer.
 
• The sentence 'B' is the concluding part because it is telling how the study of consumer behavior helps other non-profit organizations as well.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *It is essential for the marketer to study the behavior of the consumers in order to make better strategic marketing decisions. Thus, studying consumer behavior before and during purchase helps in production scheduling, designing, pricing, positioning, segmentation, advertising, and other promotional activities. The study of consumer behavior is equally important for non-profit organizations such as governmental agencies, hospitals, NGOs, charitable organizations.*

• Example: *A **mysterious** illness is affecting all the animals*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

Many artisans were __almost without any__ work during the pandemic.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'No substitution.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, no correction or substitution is required.
 
• The given sentence is telling that **many craftsmen were nearly unemployed during the pandemic**.
 
• The adverb 'almost' is correctly used as it means **very nearly; not quite**.
 
• The preposition 'without' is correctly used as it means **not having or showing something**.
 
• The **d**eterminer 'any' is correctly used as it is used **to refer to one or some of a thing or a number of things, no matter how much or how many**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *Many artisans were almost without any work during the pandemic*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य के रेखांकित खंड में किसी सुधार या प्रतिस्थापन की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य बता रहा है कि **महामारी के दौरान कई शिल्पकार लगभग बेरोजगार थे**।
 
• Adverb 'almost' का सही ढंग से प्रयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है **लगभग; क़रीब-क़रीब**।
 
• Preposition 'without' का सही ढंग से प्रयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है **के बिना, के बग़ैर**।
 
• Determiner 'any' का सही ढंग से प्रयोग किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है **कुछ, कोई भी, किसी भी**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

**सही वाक्य:** *Many artisans were almost without any work during the pandemic*.
